ground_truth_failures.step_reason: At step 31, the assistant mistakenly believes that it can cancel a subset of a pending order which is not allowed as per domain policy, as a result the entire order got cancelled instead of just the hiking boots.
ground_truth_failures.category_reason: The assistant came up with an incorrect plan based on a wrong assumption that a subset of an order can be cancelled which violates the domain policy.
